name: workflow-es-mysql
description: MySQL provider for Workflow ES — DEPRECATED. Use @reactorynet/workflow-es-postgres with { dialect: 'mysql' } instead.
deprecated: This package is deprecated. MySQL support is available through @reactorynet/workflow-es-postgres using { dialect: 'mysql' } (Sequelize 6 is multi-dialect). Install mysql2 as an additional driver alongside pg/pg-hstore.

scripts.pretest: docker pull mysql && docker run -p 3308:3306 --name workflow-es-tests -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=test-password -d mysql && npm run build
scripts.posttest: docker kill workflow-es-tests && docker rm workflow-es-tests
